tagline: A tarot of tides and moonlight

intros.major: Twenty-two trumps tracing a journey from the Fool's first step to the World's completion. In a reading they mark the great forces and turning points.
intros.wands: Fire. Will, passion and the spark that sets things in motion.
intros.cups: Water. Feeling, love, intuition and the tides of the heart.
intros.swords: Air. Thought, truth and conflict: the mind's clarity and its edge.
intros.pentacles: Earth. Body, work, home and the slow growth of what lasts.
